# Direct Exchange client tests need scriptable callbacks and observable completion

Entry 2075 makes the EWS client/callback IDL interfaces scriptable, creates the native client from JS and initializes it with a local fake-server URL. The implemented test actually calls syncFolderHierarchy despite the original test_syncMessagesForFolder filename. It checks root ID, expected and unique create IDs, final count/token, rejects unexpected update/delete and forwards errors to promise rejection. Three empty skipped tasks leave batching, second-page and non-Create behavior untested. Fixed source has a dedicated exchange/test/unit/test_syncFolderHierarchy.js, IExchangeClient and an onSuccess completion promise. Check calls and manifest registration when judging test coverage. No native build or runtime run.

Scope: Exchange direct-client unit test contracts.
